name: skillz
description: Personal marketplace of Claude Code skills, plugins, agents and slash commands, synced across machines

plugins.name: ai-native-sdlc
plugins.description: Runs the six-stage AI-native SDLC from Anthropic's playbook: intent, spec, plan, verified build, gated deploy and closed-loop maintenance, with PreToolUse hooks that enforce protected paths, frozen tests during a fix, and the production release gate.

plugins.name: linkedin-post-writer
plugins.description: Draft a new LinkedIn post from scratch using one of 20 2026 hook formulas (anaphora, R.I.P., time-anchor, curiosity-gap, contrarian, controlled A/B, false-binary, and more) plus a founders-edition angle library, picked by engagement goal (comments, reposts, likes, saves). Runs the humanizer pass and schedules via Publora on approval. Use to write a post, find a hook or proven format, or get founder-specific angles. Not for reviewing existing drafts (use linkedin-humanizer --mode audit).

plugins.name: personal-toolkit
plugins.description: Personal collection of standalone agents, slash commands and skills that follow me across machines

plugins.name: pretty-mermaid
plugins.description: Render beautiful Mermaid diagrams as SVG or ASCII art using the beautiful-mermaid library. Supports 15+ themes and 5 diagram types (flowchart, sequence, state, class, ER).

plugins.name: showcase-readme
plugins.description: Generate a portfolio-grade README that makes hiring managers and recruiters stop scrolling - hero with badges, a real recorded GIF demo of the program running, Mermaid architecture diagrams, measured performance numbers, engineering highlights and a roadmap. Use when the user asks to make, redesign or polish a README for a project they want to show employers, recruiters or a portfolio, or asks for a demo GIF or architecture diagram for their repo.
